title: Kei Hea ngā Kōnae kua Tikiakehia? He Aratohu Android, iPhone
description: Kāore e kitea ō kōnae kua tikiakehia? Anei te wāhi e tiakina ai i Android, iPhone, iPad me te rorohiko, me te nuku ataata ki te Gallery, ki Photos rānei.
photoCaption: He rerekē te wāhi o ngā kōnae i Android me iPhone.
photo2Caption: I te rorohiko, ka haere ngā kōnae ki te kōpaki Downloads.
body:
Kua pēhi kē koe i te pātene tikiake, engari kāore e kitea te ataata i tō Gallery? Kaua e māharahara, he raru tino noa tēnei. I te nuinga o te wā kua tiakina kē te kōnae, engari kei tētahi kōpaki kē atu i tāu i whakaaro ai. Ka whakamārama tēnei aratohu i te wāhi e tiakina ai ngā kōnae kua tikiakehia i Android, iPhone, iPad me te rorohiko, me te nuku i aua kōnae kia māmā ai te huaki.

Ko ngā whakamārama i raro nei mō ngā kōnae ka tikiakehia e koe mā te pūtirotiro, tae atu ki ngā ataata, ngā oro me ngā whakaahua mai i I Need Save. Ka tukuna tika ngā kōnae mai i te pūhara taketake ki tō pūrere, ā, kāore e puritia ki te tūmau o I Need Save, nō reira kei tō ake waea, rorohiko rānei anake te tārua.

Te wāhi o ngā kōnae kua tikiakehia i Android

I Android, ka haere ngā kōnae ka tikiakehia mā te pūtirotiro ki te kōpaki Downloads (Ngā Tikiake). Me pēhea te huaki:

  1. Huakina te taupānga whakahaere kōnae o tō waea. He rerekē te ingoa e ai ki te waitohu, hei tauira, ko My Files, ko Files, ko File Manager rānei.
  2. Kōwhiria te tahua Downloads, Ngā Tikiake rānei.
  3. Whakaraupapahia mā te rā hou rawa kia noho ai ngā kōnae hou ki runga rawa.
  4. Pātōtia te kōnae hei whakatangi, pēhia roatia rānei hei nuku, hei whakaingoa anō, hei tiri rānei.

He huarahi tere ake anō: huakina te tahua o tō pūtirotiro, kātahi ka kōwhiri i te wāhanga Downloads. Kei reira te rārangi o ngā kōnae hou i tiakina e koe, ā, ka taea e koe te huaki tika mai i reira.

He aha te ataata kāore anō i puta ki te Gallery?

I ētahi wā he wā poto e hiahiatia ana e te taupānga Gallery hei matawai i ngā kōnae hou. Mēnā kāore anō kia kitea te ataata, tatari mō tētahi wā poto, kātahi ka kati, ka huaki anō i te taupānga Gallery. I ētahi waea, ka whakaaturia ngā ataata mai i te kōpaki Download ki tētahi pukaemi motuhake ko Download, ko Downloads rānei te ingoa, nō reira tirohia hoki te rārangi pukaemi.

Te wāhi o ngā kōnae kua tikiakehia i iPhone me iPad

I iPhone me iPad, kāore ngā kōnae ka tikiakehia mā Safari e haere tika ki te taupānga Photos. Ka tiakina kē ki te taupānga Files (Kōnae), ki te kōpaki Downloads (Ngā Tikiake).

Kia taea ai te mātakitaki i te ataata mai i te taupānga Photos, whāia ēnei hipanga:

  1. Huakina te taupānga Files.
  2. Haere ki te kōpaki Downloads.
  3. Pātōtia te ataata e hiahia ana koe ki te nuku kia tuwhera rā anō.
  4. Pātōtia te pātene Share (Tiri).
  5. Kōwhiria Save Video.

Kātahi ka puta te ataata ki te taupānga Photos i te taha o ō atu ataata. Mō ngā whakaahua, he ōrite te tikanga: huakina te whakaahua i Files, pātōtia Share, kātahi ka kōwhiri i te kōwhiringa hei tiaki i te whakaahua.

Ka oti te ataata te tiaki ki Photos, ka taea e koe te muku i te tārua kei te kōpaki Downloads kia wātea tonu ai te rokiroki o tō iPhone.

Te wāhi o ngā kōnae kua tikiakehia i te rorohiko

I Windows me Mac, ka haere te nuinga o ngā kōnae ka tikiakehia mā te pūtirotiro ki te kōpaki Downloads (Ngā Tikiake).

  • Windows: huakina a File Explorer, kātahi ka pāwhiri i Downloads i te paewhiri mauī.
  • Mac: huakina a Finder, kātahi ka kōwhiri i Downloads i te pae taha (sidebar).
  • Mai i te pūtirotiro: huakina te rārangi tikiake o te pūtirotiro. Hei tauira, i Chrome mō Windows, ka taea e koe te pēhi i te Ctrl+J.

Mēnā kua huri koe i ngā tautuhinga o tō pūtirotiro kia tiakina ngā kōnae ki tētahi atu kōpaki, tirohia taua kōpaki mā ngā tautuhinga tikiake o tō pūtirotiro.

Kei hea ngā kōnae oro me ngā whakaahua e tiakina ai?

He ōrite te wāhi ki ngā ataata. Ka haere te oro, ahakoa he kounga taketake, he MP3 192 kbps rānei kua hurihia mai i te ataata, ki te kōpaki Downloads. He pērā anō ngā whakaahua me ngā whakaahua iti. I Android, ka taea te whakatangi i ngā kōnae MP3 mai i te taupānga whakahaere kōnae, i tētahi taupānga puoro rānei. I iPhone, ka taea te whakatangi tika i ngā kōnae oro mai i te taupānga Files.

Mēnā e hiahia ana koe ki te mōhio me pēhea te tiki oro mai i tētahi ataata, pānuitia te aratohu mō te huri ataata pāpāho pāpori hei MP3.

Kāore rawa he kōnae? Tirohia ēnei

  • Kāore anō kia oti te tikiake. Me tukatuka tuatahi ētahi ataata, ā, ka whakaatu te pātene i te E whakarite ana…. Tatari kia tīmata aunoa te tikiake, ā, kaua e kati wawe i te whārangi.
  • Kua kī te rokiroki. Mēnā kua tata pau te rokiroki, ka rahua pea te tikiake. Whakawāteatia he wāhi iti, kātahi ka ngana anō.
  • Kāore e taea te ihirangi te tikiake. Kāore rawa e taea te tiaki i ngā ihirangi tūmataiti, i ngā ihirangi e hiahia ana kia takiuru, i ngā ihirangi kua herea ā-rohe rānei.

Mēnā kua kitea te kōnae engari kāore e tākaro, tirohia ngā rongoā i te tuhinga mō ngā ataata kua tikiakehia kāore e tākaro.

Kotahi anō: tiakina ngā ihirangi mō tō ake whakamahinga anake, ā, whakautetia te mana pupuri o ngā kaihanga. Mēnā e hiahia ana koe ki te tuku anō, tonoa tuatahitia he whakaaetanga, ā, whakaingoatia te kaihanga.

Ngā pātai auau

Ka taea te huri i te wāhi e tiakina ai ngā kōnae kua tikiakehia?

I te rorohiko, ka āhei koe i te nuinga o ngā pūtirotiro ki te kōwhiri i te kōpaki tikiake mā te tahua tautuhinga. I te waea, ka whakawhirinaki tēnei kōwhiringa ki te pūtirotiro me te pūnaha e whakamahia ana e koe.

He aha i kore ai te ataata e haere tika ki Photos i te iPhone?

Ka tiakina e Safari ngā kōnae kua tikiakehia ki te taupānga Files. Me huaki koe i te ataata i Files, pātōtia Share, kātahi ka kōwhiri i Save Video.

Ka tiakina ōku kōnae ki te tūmau o I Need Save?

Kāo. Ka tukuna tika ngā kōnae mai i te pūhara taketake ki tō pūrere, nō reira tiakina paitia ō kōnae hira.
